digest.component_or_area: LLM provider construction and lifecycle management
propositions: Provider construction logic is currently inlined in run() with provider-specific branches (startswith checks) scattered across runner.py, making it difficult to add new providers

ProviderSession must own the lifecycle of httpx.AsyncClient and other closeables returned by provider builders, since pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook signature only returns a Provider with no channel for cleanup
The anthropic provider builder must move from runner.py into providers.py while preserving the existing tenacity transport, max_retries=0 guard, and per-request timeout behavior
run() must wrap its execution in ProviderSession as a context manager so that all opened clients are closed in both success and exception paths
Existing unit tests that directly import _build_retrying_anthropic_model must update their import sites from rebar.llm.runner to rebar.llm.anthropic_model without behavior change
